Best for: which pull length for a drawer width, what fits existing holes (center-to-center), knobs versus pulls, fin

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the live Knobs.co catalog by item type, size, finish, brand or series ("5 inch pull satin nickel", "Top Knobs Lynwood", "3 inch matte black pull"). Returns up to 10 products with vendor, center-to-center size, overall length, finishes, list prices, variant ids and product URLs. Sizes and fini

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Every variant (finish, SKU, list price, variant id) of one product by its handle (from search_catalog or a knobs.co/products/<handle> URL), with sizes and description.

tools.name: sizing_guide
tools.description: Knobs.co's sizing rules: which pull length for which drawer width, the standard 128 mm size, knobs versus pulls, one pull or two, and how to measure existing holes. No arguments.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: What Knobs.co is, what it sells, how to buy, samples, trade program, how to reach a person, and how this service works. No arguments.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Knobs.co products. Returns {results:[{id,title,url}]} where id is the product handle for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one Knobs.co product document by id (the handle from search). Returns {id,title,text,url,metadata}.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
